Name: Baldur's Gate Portraits inspired by Nyapu
Author: BEETLEBOXED
Description:
[i][center]***

Because of limited bug testing, there may be issues with the mod! Please report anything so I can get it fixed ASAP.[/center]
[center]***[/center][/i]

[size=4]OVERVIEW[/size]
Portraits for Baldur's Gate characters in the style of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11491]Nyapu's Portraits[/url]. 

[size=4]CURRENTLY SUPPORTED[/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20362]Baldur's Valley - BG3 Replacement Mod[/url] - Astarion and Karlach
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20675]Baldur's Valley[/url] - Astarion, Karlach, Scratch, and Wyll
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30888]Baldur's Village[/url]﻿ - Astarion, Karlach, and Wyll
[/list]
[size=4]SOON™[/size]
[list]
[*]Baldur's Valley - Gale, Shadowheart, Strange Ox, and anyone else added.
[*]Baldur's Village - Lae'zel, Omeluum, Halsin, and others! 
[/list]
